title: Six-class metered rho v13c: v13b's production mechanism under the review-passed 0.392 success budget

claims.statement: Conditional analytic full-production secp256k1 ECDLP claim: the specified six-class (negation and GLV) parallel rho walk with doubling escapes, a global work meter and a 2^16-node report partition recovers a uniform challenge logarithm with probability at least 0.39 within 2^127 classical target-operation equivalents at protected C=1000. Let r be the secp256k1 group order, N=(r-1)/6 classes, R=2^20 twisted table entries, DP spacing 2^69, 2^20 workers, 2^16 storage nodes with 2^43-record caps, 192-byte records. The success budget is the review-passed 0.392 shape: S_ops=ceil(sqrt(2*mu*N'*ln(1000/608))) with N'=N*R/(R-1) and mu=1.058, the walk inefficiency implied by the captured DP-2 pipeline row (1,610 of 4,000 all-arrival collisions at the v13b budget give mu=1.05772), so S_ops=2^126.74469 is the hard phase-1 arrival counter and mu up to 1.061530 still meets the floor. The ordinary step is priced 1.11 units: one reference batched affine addition (C=1000, 6M=1074 instructions, not charged twice) plus a 21-row itemised control ceiling of 110 instructions. Doubling is priced 2.35 (7M+6A+3M inversion share+200 with M<=200 limb-counted). Phase 1 is 2^126.89525, hard extras below 2^89.01, expected doubling surcharge 2^107.28, raw ledger 2^126.89525, and the 27/25 reserve gives 2^127.00628. Success is eta_model=0.392 minus a Markov early-halt below 0.00002 and listed probability debits totalling below 0.001, hence at least 0.39. The escape mechanism is specified exactly: a two-key compare catches two-cycles under one fingerprint order and doubles the minimum-fingerprint member, and a 64-step checkpoint window with a traversal-minimum test catches cycles of length up to 64 within 64L arrivals; both escape to class(2c(Z)) for the minimum member Z of the detected cycle, clear history, and preserve the exponent pair up to an exact unit factor, so distinguished-point matches in one shared table yield x=(u*beta2-beta1)/(alpha1-u*alpha2) mod r and only an [x]P0==T candidate counts. The toy implements that mechanism end to end and recovers 4000 of 4000 verified logarithms. H1 (all-arrival collision statistic), the six-class twist uniformity clause, the truncated canonical-index rule with its metered exact fallback (8-product error at most 8 ulps, 40-ulp threshold, fallback rate bounded at 294/2^64) and the instruction ceilings are disclosed heuristics supported at toy scale only; this is not an unconditional theorem and no production execution is claimed.
